basic_info.description: Welcome to Residence 224, a fully furnished gem nestled atop iconic Ghirardelli Square. This residence invites you into a world where luxury & convenience seamlessly merge with charm & history. Step out your front door to the expansive Mustard Terrace, a sanctuary offering unparalleled vistas of the Bay, Alcatraz & Aquatic Park. Whether basking in the sun-drenched terrace or relaxing in the living room w floor-to-ceiling windows & a gas fireplace, every moment here is a testament to the beauty of this iconic locale. The open-concept living & dining area blends effortlessly into the mesmerizing Bay views, evoking tranquility & sophistication. Two spacious bedrooms invite you to unwind and rejuvenate. Ensuite bathrooms offer added privacy and comfort, meticulously crafted to enhance your living experience. Indulge your culinary passions in the gourmet kitchen, featuring top-of-the-line appliances such as a Subzero fridge, Wolf gas range, & Subzero wine fridge. The Bosch washer-dryer ensure convenience, while the inclusion of furniture, housewares, TVs & a sound system adds luxury & ease. Garage parking is included.  For added income, the HOA allows for nightly rentals. The historic building also features a private owner's lounge, a fitness center & concierge services.
